title: Snooze locked phone
symptom: Snoozing an xDrip 'Low Alert' using the volume button of the phone no longer works. The user has to unlock the screen and swipe to snooze the sound. When the alert rings when the screen is already unlocked, volume buttons do not snooze; they only work after locking and unlocking the screen.
cause: The thread explains that snoozing an alert via volume buttons when the phone is locked has never been possible (see issue #73). The behavior is due to Android limitations: you cannot receive those broadcasts unless the screen is on or there is active audio playing.
fix: To snooze an alert while the phone is locked, change Android notification settings to show notification details on lock screen, and enable the xDrip setting that turns the screen on when there is a notification. Then, when an alert triggers, swipe the notification right to snooze.
settings_changed: Android notification settings → show notification details on lock screen
xDrip setting that turns the screen on when there is a notification → enabled
evidence_quote: By default, you cannot snooze an alert when your phone is locked.  But, you can change a few settings to make it possible. First, you need to change an Android notifications setting so that it would show notification details on lock screen. Then, there is a relatively new xDrip setting that turns the screen on when there is a notidication. After that, as soon as an alert triggers, you will see the notification on the screen of your phone, and swiping it right will snooze the alert with your phone still locked.
